items.passage: The box of old photographs ______ on the top shelf of the closet.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее — box (единственное число), «of old photographs» лишь уточняет. Нужен глагол в единственном числе: sits (B). sit, are sitting и have sat — формы множественного числа.

items.passage: Each of the students ______ a different topic for the report.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «Each» — единственное число, поэтому has chosen (B). Остальные варианты согласованы с students во множественном числе.

items.passage: Yesterday, the class ______ a trip to the science museum.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «Yesterday» требует прошедшего времени: took (C). takes и will take — настоящее и будущее; taking — не личная форма, предложение остаётся без сказуемого.

items.passage: The ______ tails were wagging as their owner came through the door.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Хвосты (tails) у нескольких собак — притяжательная форма множественного числа: dogs' (A). dog's — одна собака, но хвостов несколько; dogs без апострофа — не притяжательная форма; dogs's — неверное написание.

items.passage: Neither the coach nor the players ______ satisfied with the result.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: При «neither… nor» глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим — players: were (A). was, is и has been — единственное число.

items.passage: Sofia and her brother ______ to school together every morning.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Два подлежащих через and — множественное число: walk (A). walks, is walking и has walked — единственное число.

items.passage: The museum displays a collection of ancient coins, some of ______ are more than two thousand years old.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «some of which» вводит придаточное о монетах (B). who — только о людях; «some of them» даёт comma splice; it — единственное число и тоже comma splice.

items.passage: Every morning, my father ______ coffee and reads the newspaper.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее father — единственное число, и глагол параллелен reads: drinks (D). drink и have drunk не согласованы; drinking — не личная форма.

items.passage: A ______ wings are covered with tiny scales that give them their color.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Артикль «A» указывает на одну бабочку — притяжательная форма единственного числа: butterfly's (B). butterflies' — множественное, не сочетается с «A»; butterflies — не притяжательная; butterflys' — неверное написание.

items.passage: By the time we arrived, the movie ______ already started.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Действие произошло раньше другого прошедшего действия (arrived) — past perfect: had started (B). has — настоящее время; have не согласовано с movie; having не образует сказуемого.

items.passage: Last Friday, the team ______ its new uniforms for the first game of the season.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «Last Friday» — прошедшее время, team — единственное число: wore (A). wears — настоящее; wearing — не личная форма; have worn — множественное число и не то время.

items.passage: My cousin, along with her two friends, ______ planning a trip to the mountains.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Оборот «along with her two friends» не делает подлежащее множественным: cousin — is (D). are, were и have been — формы множественного числа.

items.passage: When Lucia finished the race, ______ felt proud of her time.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Местоимение заменяет Lucia и стоит в роли подлежащего: she (B). they — множественное; it — не о человеке; them — объектная форма.

items.passage: The cookies ______ on the counter smell delicious.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «sitting on the counter» — определение к cookies, а сказуемое предложения — smell: sitting (C). sits и sat создают второе сказуемое без союза; «they sit» — лишнее подлежащее.

items.passage: There ______ many reasons to visit the national park in autumn.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: В обороте there + be глагол согласуется с тем, что после него: reasons — множественное, are (A). is, was и has been — единственное число.

items.passage: The results of the survey, which was conducted in three cities, ______ that most residents support the new park.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее — results (множественное число); survey и вставка его не меняют: suggest (B). suggests, is suggesting и has suggested — единственное число.

items.passage: Founded in 1636, ______
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: people regard Harvard University as the oldest institution of higher education in the United States.
there are no American universities older than Harvard University.
many students apply to Harvard University each year.
Harvard University is the oldest institution of higher education in the United States.
items.explanation: Оборот «Founded in 1636» должен относиться к тому, что основано, — к университету, стоящему сразу после запятой (D). В остальных вариантах после запятой идут people, there и students — получается, что основаны они.

items.passage: Neither of the two proposals ______ the committee's full support.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «Neither of» — единственное число: has (D). have, are having и were having — множественное.

items.passage: The flock of geese ______ south every autumn, stopping at the same lakes along the way.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее flock — единственное число, и «every autumn» требует простого настоящего: flies (C). fly, are flying и have flown — множественное число.

items.passage: The chemist carefully measured each substance, ______ the results in a notebook.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Причастный оборот «recording the results» присоединяется к главному предложению запятой (A). records и recorded создают второе сказуемое без союза; «she records» — comma splice.

items.passage: Our neighbors, the Garcias, invited us to ______ anniversary party.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Притяжательное местоимение для neighbors: their (C). there — «там»; they're — «they are»; its — единственное число.

items.passage: If the bridge ______ built a few years earlier, the town's economy might have grown faster.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Нереальное условие в прошлом: if + past perfect, затем might have grown — had been (B). was — реальное прошедшее; has been — настоящее совершенное; would be не употребляется в if-части.

items.passage: The number of electric cars on the road ______ grown rapidly over the past decade.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «The number of» — единственное число: has (B). have — множественное; are и were не образуют present perfect с grown.

items.passage: The professor gave the students ______ instructions before the exam began.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Слово определяет существительное instructions — нужно прилагательное clear (A). clearly — наречие; «clearer than» требует продолжения сравнения; clearness — существительное.

items.passage: Walking along the beach at sunset, ______
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: there was a pod of dolphins leaping offshore.
Mia spotted a pod of dolphins leaping offshore.
a pod of dolphins was spotted leaping offshore.
the dolphins leaped offshore as Mia watched.
items.explanation: Тот, кто шёл по пляжу, должен стоять сразу после оборота — Mia (B). В остальных вариантах выходит, что по пляжу шли дельфины или «there».

items.passage: Among the items found in the ancient tomb ______ a bronze mirror and a set of carved dice.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Инверсия: подлежащее идёт после глагола — «a bronze mirror and a set of carved dice», множественное число, а рассказ в прошедшем: were (A). was, is и has been — единственное число.

items.passage: The novel's main characters, a detective and her assistant, travel across Europe as ______ search for a stolen painting.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Местоимение заменяет characters (двое): they (C). she и he указывают на одного; it — не о людях.

items.passage: The city council voted to approve the budget, ______ includes funding for two new libraries.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Придаточное о budget после запятой вводится which (A). who — только о людях; «that it includes» и «and it which» — неграмматичны.

items.passage: Scientists believe that the ______ ability to navigate long distances depends partly on Earth's magnetic field, which they can sense.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Местоимение they в конце указывает на множественное число — притяжательная форма sea turtles' (A). sea turtle's — единственное, не согласуется с they; формы без апострофа не притяжательные.

items.passage: Last spring, the students ______ tomatoes in the school garden; this year, they are growing peppers.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «Last spring» — прошедшее время: planted (C). plant и are planting — настоящее; will plant — будущее, противоречит «last spring».

items.passage: The collection of essays, along with several unpublished letters, ______ to the university library after the author's death.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее collection — единственное число; «along with…» его не меняет; события в прошлом: was donated (C). were и have been — множественное; are — настоящее время.

items.passage: Each of the three bridges that cross the river ______ designed by a different engineer.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: «Each of» — единственное число, мосты построены в прошлом: was (C). were, are и have been — множественное число.

items.passage: To reduce costs, ______
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: costs were reduced by switching suppliers.
switching to a cheaper supplier was the company's decision.
the company switched to a cheaper supplier.
a cheaper supplier was chosen by the company.
items.explanation: Цель «To reduce costs» относится к тому, кто действует, — к компании, стоящей сразу после запятой (C). Иначе выходит, что сокращать расходы хотел поставщик, сами расходы или «switching».

items.passage: The findings that the researchers published last year ______ that the river's temperature has risen.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее findings — множественное число; придаточное «that the researchers published» его не меняет: indicate (A). Остальные формы — единственное число.

items.passage: Unlike the novels of her contemporaries, ______
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: Austen's novels focus closely on the daily lives of a few families.
Austen focused closely on the daily lives of a few families.
there is a close focus in Austen's novels on the daily lives of a few families.
readers find that Austen focused closely on the daily lives of a few families.
items.explanation: Сравнивать нужно романы с романами: «Unlike the novels…, Austen's novels…» (A). В остальных вариантах романы современников сравниваются с самой Остин, с «there» или с читателями.

items.passage: The committee ______ unable to agree on a date, so the meeting was postponed.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Собирательное committee в американском английском — единственное число, события в прошлом: was (C). were и have been — множественное; are — настоящее время.

items.passage: The pottery shards, ______ were discovered beneath the old market square, date back to the eleventh century.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Придаточное-вставка о предметах вводится which (D). who — о людях; «that they» и it — неграмматичны во вставке.

items.passage: Having studied the migration patterns of whales for decades, ______
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: the findings of the marine biologist were summarized in a book.
publishing a book was the marine biologist's next step.
the marine biologist published a book summarizing her findings.
a book summarizing the marine biologist's findings was published.
items.explanation: Изучал китов биолог — он должен стоять сразу после оборота (C). Иначе выходит, что китов изучали книга, выводы или «publishing».

items.passage: One of the reasons that the town's population declined ______ the closure of its largest factory.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Подлежащее one — единственное число; reasons внутри оборота его не меняет: was (B). were, are и have been — множественное.

items.passage: The scientists hoped that the new telescope ______ them to observe galaxies that formed shortly after the Big Bang.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: После прошедшего hoped ожидание выражается через would: would allow (D). allows — настоящее время; allowing и to allow не образуют сказуемого.

items.passage: Not only the teacher but also the students ______ excited about the field trip.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: В «not only… but also» глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим — students: were (D). was, is и has been — единственное число.

items.passage: Like ______ of many desert animals, the fennec fox's large ears help it release body heat.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Сравниваются уши с ушами; those заменяет «the ears» во множественном числе (A). that — единственное число; it и them сравнивали бы уши лисы с самими животными.

items.passage: The author argues that a city's parks, more than ______ museums or monuments, shape residents' sense of community.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: Музеи принадлежат городу (a city's) — единственное число: its (A). their указывало бы на parks; it's — «it is»; there — «там».

items.passage: Rarely ______ such a complete fossil of an early bird been found.
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
items.explanation: После «Rarely» в начале — инверсия, подлежащее fossil единственного числа, и с «been found» нужно has (B). have — множественное; is и was не образуют форму с been.

items.passage: The orchestra performed works by three composers: a symphony by Brahms, a concerto by Grieg, and ______
items.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: a set of songs by Schubert.
items.explanation: Элементы списка должны быть параллельны: «a symphony by…, a concerto by…, and a set of songs by…» (A). Остальные варианты ломают параллелизм — появляются новые предложения или придаточные.
